assumptions: The archive is a QuantStudio `.eds` as qslib reads it (both the 1.x and 2.x layouts).
limits: Reads what the instrument wrote: a run still in progress carries fewer collection points than its programme, and says so rather than padding them.
Which dye is the passive reference is a fact about the assay, not the file, so it is a parameter and is never guessed.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: A reader: the run as the archive records it, with nothing inferred. The readings belong to the tools that analyze the curves it hands on (call_cq, bootstrap_cq).
bio.jane/contract.question: What run, plate, dyes and amplification curves does this QuantStudio .eds hold?

description: Read an Applied Biosystems / Thermo QuantStudio `.eds` experiment: what the run holds (its name, plate, dyes, collection points and stages) and, on request, the amplification curves as a cycle × well table ready for call_cq. read_rdml_run reads the other instrument format; an `.eds` is not an RDML document in another spelling, so it has its own reader.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

curves.description: also return the amplification curves as a cycle × well table (tab-separated), which is what call_cq takes as its `table`.

dye.description: the reporter dye the curves are read from. Empty takes the run's first dye, and the answer says which. Only applies when curves is true.

file.description: the `.eds` to read, by name, from the project or the `_files` sent with the call. Empty reads the only one there.

passive_reference.description: the dye to normalize against, giving Rn (reporter ÷ passive). Empty emits the raw reporter signal and says so: picking ROX silently would be a normalization nobody chose. Only applies when curves is true.

name: read_eds_run

dyes.description: the dyes this run carries, in the archive’s order

normalization.description: what the table carries: the reporter's raw signal, or Rn against the named passive reference

points.description: collection points — the cycles, which is what a curve has to be fitted over

summary.description: the run as the archive states it: name, specVersion, plate, wells, collection points, dyes and the stages they came from

table.description: the amplification curves as a tab-separated cycle × well table, when `curves` was asked for. Wire it into call_cq

wells.description: wells the archive holds readings for
